_comment: Hand-written store release notes for 10.8.0, in both listing languages. tool/gen_changelog.py prefers this file over anything it can derive from the commits, then runs it through the same per-store platform gate as every other source — so keep every line free of operating-system, device and store names. One line per bullet; the leading bullet character is added when the note is written. Keep it short: the Play note is capped at 480 characters including the bullets.
en:
Shift planning: plan events and shifts, sign up yourself, with a waiting list and a calendar
Subscribe to your shifts in your own calendar and export plans
Search across every part of the app and open a person's profile
Budgets in hours and a billable switch per project
Many smaller fixes and improvements
de:
Schichtplanung: Veranstaltungen und Schichten planen, selbst eintragen, mit Warteliste und Kalender
Die eigenen Schichten im eigenen Kalender abonnieren und Pläne exportieren
Überall in der App suchen und das Profil einer Person öffnen
Budgets in Stunden und ein Schalter für Abrechenbarkeit je Projekt
Viele kleinere Korrekturen und Verbesserungen
